caption: The drawing features a symmetrical, floral design centered around a large, green vase-like object within a tilted square (diamond shape) outlined in green. From this central vase, green vines shoot outward, each terminating with red, yellow, or turquoise flowers and green leaves. Surrounding the central diamond is a background filled with additional winding green vines, also adorned with similar red, yellow, and turquoise flowers. In the top section outside the central diamond are two stylized vessel-like figures—one red and one green—each outlined with a secondary color, and a small, blue, five-pointed star beneath the green vessel. The entire composition is set on a beige or tan background, which gives the various colors prominence. The floral motifs repeat around the edges, maintaining the green, red, yellow, and turquoise palette, with all shapes drawn with distinct outlines.
title: Applique Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
